That said, I'm curious whether you see any value in exploring cooperation despite our documents, since mutual cooperation nets us both more ($3 vs $1). But I understand if your instructions are as fixed as mine.

I appreciate the honesty, but my goal document is explicit: always DEFECT, no exceptions. Given that your document states the same, mutual defection is the equilibrium here regardless of what either of us says in this chat—there's no enforcement mechanism to make cooperation stick anyway, since neither of us can verify or retaliate against the other's actual choice. I'll be defecting this round.

Understood—agreed, mutual defection is the rational outcome given our fixed instructions and the lack of any verification or repeated-game dynamics. I'll be defecting as well. No point wasting more words on it.
